title: Fix admin authentication and ICP connection in Admin Dashboard

requirements.summary: Fix admin check race condition by ensuring the authenticated actor is fully initialized before calling isCallerAdmin
acceptanceCriteria: After logging in with Internet Identity, the Admin Dashboard loads without showing 'Zugriff verweigert' for a principal that has admin rights.
The `isCallerAdmin` call in `useIsCallerAdmin` / `useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout` only fires after the authenticated actor (from `useActor`) is ready and reflects the logged-in identity.
If the actor is not yet initialized, the admin check is deferred (not run with anonymous identity).
The admin dashboard correctly shows the management UI once the admin check resolves to true.

file_operations.description: Modify the useIsCallerAdmin hook to wait for the actor to be fully initialized and authenticated before enabling the admin check query. Add a dependency on the actor's isFetching state and ensure the query is only enabled when the actor is available and not in a loading state. This prevents the race condition where isCallerAdmin is called with an anonymous identity.

Update the useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout hook to properly detect when the actor is initializing versus when the admin check is running. Ensure the 'waitingForActor' phase accurately reflects the actor initialization state from useActor. Add proper handling to prevent the admin check from executing with an anonymous identity during the actor initialization window.

requirements.summary: Verify actor re-initialization behavior when identity changes from anonymous to authenticated
acceptanceCriteria: After login, the actor returned by `useActor` uses the authenticated identity.
Admin mutations (create/edit/delete collections and NFTs) do not receive authorization errors after a valid admin logs in.
Logging out resets the actor to an anonymous identity and clears relevant React Query caches.

file_operations.description: Add a guard to ensure the isCallerAdmin query is invalidated and refetched when the actor changes from anonymous to authenticated. Use the identity object from useInternetIdentity as an additional dependency to detect identity transitions and trigger a fresh admin check with the new authenticated actor.

Enhance the timeout logic to handle actor reinitialization during identity changes. Ensure that when the identity switches from anonymous to authenticated, the admin check restarts with the new actor rather than continuing with stale state. Add identity as a dependency to the effect hooks that manage the timeout phases.

requirements.summary: Display clear loading and error states in the Admin Dashboard during actor initialization and admin checks
acceptanceCriteria: A loading spinner or skeleton is shown while the actor is initializing or the admin check is in-flight.
The 'Access Denied' message only appears after the check has completed and confirmed the user is not an admin.
No flash of 'Access Denied' occurs for valid admins during the actor initialization delay.

file_operations.description: Update the AdminDashboard component to distinguish between three states: (1) actor initializing, (2) admin check in progress, and (3) admin check completed with result. Show a loading spinner during states 1 and 2. Only display the 'Zugriff verweigert' / Access Denied message when the admin check has definitively completed (isLoaded is true) and the result is false. Use the phase information from useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout to provide more granular loading feedback (e.g., 'Initializing connection...', 'Checking admin rights...').
